configurationFields.label: Server Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Sets Stable or Autobuild (nightly) release stream. Needs "Server Version" set as well. NOTE: Update the server after changing this setting!

configurationFields.label: Server Version
configurationFields.description: [Stable build version](https://xonotic.org/download/) or [Autobuild version](https://beta.xonotic.org/autobuild/) to install. Set "Server Release Stream" as appropriate. NOTE: Update the server after changing this setting!

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Server name visible in the server list ("$g_xonoticversion" is replaced with the current version)

configurationFields.label: Server Public Status
configurationFields.description: Sets the public status of the server and whether it is included in the master server list

options.1: Public and included in server list
options.0: Public but not included in server list

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Welcome Message
configurationFields.description: Welcome message when players join the server

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of players that may connect to the server (including spectators)

configurationFields.label: Game Start Delay
configurationFields.description: Sets the delay before the game starts to let players join the server first

configurationFields.label: Maps
configurationFields.description: Space-separated list of maps for the server. Empty = all maps
configurationFields.default: afterslime atelier boil catharsis courtfun dance drain erbium finalrage fuse geoplanetary glowplant implosion leave_em_behind nexballarena oilrig runningman runningmanctf silentsiege solarium space-elevator stormkeep techassault vorix warfare xoylent

configurationFields.label: Shuffle Map List
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a random map will be selected for each game. Otherwise the maps will be selected in sequence

configurationFields.label: Minimum Maps Before Repeat
configurationFields.description: Number of maps that have to be played before a map can be repeated

configurationFields.label: Hide IPs from Clients
configurationFields.description: If enabled, IP addresses are hidden from "status" replies shown to clients
